name: EGS Custom Testimonial Form
author: eGrove Systems

sections.description:
EGS Custom Testimonial Form helps site administrators collect, moderate, organize, and display customer testimonials. The WordPress.org edition includes a functional slider layout, basic field controls, ratings, images, a testimonial submission form, reusable templates, a shortcode, and a widget.

Additional layouts, advanced styling, and advanced form fields are advertised through static preview cards only. Their implementation is not included in this WordPress.org package. No license key or external licensing service is required for any functionality included in this package.

Features

  • Create and manage testimonials in WordPress.
  • Collect testimonials through a front-end form.
  • Moderate submitted testimonials before publication.
  • Display testimonials using the included slider layout.
  • Configure the included basic testimonial fields, ratings, images, and links.
  • Preview additional Pro layouts and designs through advertisement-only cards that link to the separately distributed Pro plugin.
  • Create reusable display templates.
  • Display testimonials using a shortcode or widget.

Premium Features

The free plugin displays static preview cards for additional layouts, designs, advanced styling, and advanced form fields available in the separately distributed EGS Custom Testimonial Form Pro plugin. These preview cards are advertisements only; the Pro feature implementation is not included in this WordPress.org package.

Upgrade information: https://plugins.modulebazaar.com/product/testimonial/

The free plugin does not send site or user data to this website. The URL is opened only when an administrator clicks an upgrade link.

Third-Party Libraries

Swiper is bundled for the free slider presentation and is distributed under the MIT License.
Source: https://swiperjs.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate EGS Custom Testimonial Form.
  3. Open the Testimonials menu in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Add testimonials and create a display template.
  5. Add [egsctp_testimonials] to a page, post, or shortcode block.
sections.faq:
How do I display testimonials?

Use [egsctp_testimonials]. To use a saved template, copy the shortcode shown after saving the template.

How do I add the front-end submission form?

Add [egsctp_testimonial_form] to a page. Submitted testimonials are saved for administrator review.

Does this plugin contact an external service?

No. This WordPress.org build does not require an external service or license server.
sections.changelog:
1.0.12

  • Removed all remaining implementation code for Pro-only advanced form fields from the WordPress.org package.
  • Kept Pro layouts, designs, advanced styling, and advanced form fields as static preview/upgrade information only.
  • Preserved the existing free testimonial form, moderation, template, slider, and Design-1 flow.
  • Cleaned stale license/disabled-control CSS and legacy commented premium renderer code.

1.0.11

  • Added the required translator comments for formatted translatable strings reported by Plugin Check.
  • Updated the stable tag to match the plugin version.

1.0.10

  • Fixed free testimonial slider navigation, pagination, touch gestures, and autoplay.
  • Improved per-slider Swiper initialization so multiple testimonial sliders can work independently.

1.0.9

  • Restored the Free Slider/Design-1 frontend card to match its admin preview, including avatar, rating, role, website, quote styling, footer, pagination and responsive behavior.
  • Corrected Free testimonial meta-field lookups so saved image, role, website and rating values render properly.
  • Kept Pro-only layouts/designs as advertisement previews only.

1.0.6

  • Converted Pro-only layouts and advanced controls to advertisement-only previews.
  • Removed locked/disabled built-in premium controls and license-gating helpers.
  • Removed inline script/style output and the unnecessary direct media.php include.
  • Hardened shortcode output escaping.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
